trends.hook: Mother-in-law secretly sells family land while son is abroad
Woman discovers her husband built a second family in the village
Two sisters fight over one man at a wedding
Son returns from abroad to find his mother living on the streets
Choir mistress exposes pastor's secret affair during Sunday service

chosen_trend.hook: Mother-in-law secretly sells family land while son is abroad

screenplay.title: The Land That Tore Us Apart
screenplay.logline: When Adaeze discovers her mother-in-law secretly sold the family land meant for her children's future, she must choose between justice and family peace.

characters.name: Adaeze
characters.description: Strong-willed 32-year-old market trader, fiercely protective of her children

appearance.face: round, warm dark skin, high cheekbones
appearance.hair: shoulder-length box braids with burgundy highlights

characters.name: Mama Nneka
characters.description: Respectable grandmother with a hidden calculating side, 68

appearance.face: oval, lighter skin tone with traditional tattoos
appearance.hair: white gele headwrap, natural grey roots

characters.name: Emeka
characters.description: Adaeze's husband, mild-mannered, caught between mother and wife

appearance.face: strong jaw, smooth dark skin
appearance.hair: low fade, short

scenes.setting: Adaeze's living room — Lagos afternoon, warm sunlight through curtains
scenes.action_summary: Adaeze confronts Emeka about missing land documents. Tension rises.

dialogue.text: Emeka, where are the land documents?
I gave them to Mama Nneka last month.
Your mother sold our land. I know it.

scenes.setting: Mama Nneka's bedroom — ornate, old photos on walls
scenes.action_summary: Mama Nneka counts cash and hides the deed in a Bible.

dialogue.text: For the family, I did what I had to do.

scenes.setting: Community chief's palace — formal setting, elders present
scenes.action_summary: Family dispute brought before elders. Shocking revelation.

dialogue.text: Mama sold our children's future for her brother.
He needed the money for his hospital bills.
You both betrayed me — lying for months.

scenes.setting: Outside the palace — twilight, birds settling in trees
scenes.action_summary: Emeka and Adaeze reconcile with a plan to rebuild.

dialogue.text: We will buy it back together.
Together. And this time, no secrets.

scenes.action_summary: Adaeze opens a new business stand — new beginning.

dialogue.text: From the ashes of betrayal, we rise.
